data.action: 单膝跪地，剑尖抵着沙滩
data.camera: cowboy shot, low angle, kneeling pose and hand on the sword visible
data.description: 狂暴巨浪拍打着黑色礁石的深渊海岸线上，斯卡蒂单膝跪地，将那柄沉重如巨碑的深海大剑重重插入黑沙之中。她擦去脸颊上腥咸的海水，转过头凝视着你——「恐鱼的血已经流尽了。只要我还握得动这柄剑，任何来自深海的阴影，都休想触碰到你一根头发。」
data.promptProse: Kneeling on one knee, Skadi holds her greatsword planted in wet black sand with one hand, wiping salt spray from her cheek with the other; grey-violet dusk lights the breaking waves.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 深渊海岸
data.animaCaption: One hand steadies the greatsword while the other wipes salt spray from her cheek.
